# Automated Documentation Sync

## Use when

Use when planning or implementing the future solution that keeps documentation synchronized with source changes while preserving human approval before publishing.

## Scope

- Source changes may trigger documentation updates.
- Generated content must separate facts, assumptions, and unknowns.
- Human reviewers approve documentation updates before release.

## Deliverables

- Requirements for the sync behavior
- Architecture for trigger, analysis, generation, and review flow
- Verification for both code behavior and output quality
